This template is used to generate a linked abbreviation for sporting events (esp. football) with special ending conditions. Its most common use is to produce "(a.e.t.)", meaning "after extra time", indicating that the score shown is after the completion of overtime play. By default, the indicator has a piped link to [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|Extra time (association football)]].

{{tlc|aet}} is an alias of {{tlc|after extra time}}.

== Usage ==
Other displays and links are available using this template, through the addition of one of the parameters shown below.
